name: Same ID set in CUSTOMER and SALES
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.CUSTOMER c FULL OUTER JOIN SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.SALES s ON c."ID" = s."ID" WHERE c."ID" IS NULL OR s."ID" IS NULL

name: CUSTOMER.AMOUNT / UNIT are copies of SALES
sql: SELECT COUNT_IF(c."AMOUNT" <> s."AMOUNT"), COUNT_IF(c."UNIT" <> s."UNIT") FROM SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.CUSTOMER c JOIN SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.SALES s ON c."ID" = s."ID"

name: QA: net sales Male / Female
sql: SELECT SUM(IFF(c."GENDER" = 'Male', s."AMOUNT", 0)), SUM(IFF(c."GENDER" = 'Female', s."AMOUNT", 0)) FROM SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.SALES s JOIN SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.CUSTOMER c ON s."ID" = c."ID" WHERE s."STATUS" = 'Sold'

name: QA: net sales Office 365 / Power Platform / XBOX
sql: SELECT SUM(IFF(p."CATEGORY" = 'Office 365', s."AMOUNT", 0)), SUM(IFF(p."CATEGORY" = 'Power Platform', s."AMOUNT", 0)), SUM(IFF(p."CATEGORY" = 'XBOX', s."AMOUNT", 0)) FROM SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.SALES s JOIN SEMABRIDGE.SALES_AND_RETURNS.PRODUCT p ON s."PRODUCTID" = p."PRODUCTID" WHERE s."STATUS" = 'Sold'
